description: Find matching jobs sourced directly from company career pages: keywords, location, occupation, seniority, technology, remote/hybrid/onsite, employment type, EUR salary, experience and document language. Returns up to 5 companies with up to 3 posting summaries each, totalCompanies and a moreAt browsing link; no pagination or company filter. q accepts freetext; loc/occ/sen/tech use exact slugs returned by resolve_slugs or list_taxonomies. Use get_job_detail for salary and other available metadata, and create_watchlist_link for email-alert setup.

etype.description: Employment type, comma-separated: full_time, part_time, contract, temporary, volunteer

exp.description: Experience bounds in years, integer min-max (3-10, 3-, or -5)

lang.description: Two-letter posting document language codes, comma-separated (e.g. en,de). Independent of response locale; omitted means all document languages.

sal.description: Salary bounds in EUR, integer min-max (80000-150000, 100000-, or -80000). Not the user's display currency.

wm.description: Work mode, comma-separated: onsite, hybrid, remote

name: search_jobs
